decisions.reason: The retained 7 cm and 17 cm border measurements apply to both block-color pareos, but the candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording those options.

The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording the selected smaller-scale Zebra Obsidian option, removal of its border, and full-edge artwork treatment; the block-pareo border measurements do not apply to Zebra.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording removal of the Basket Weave border and extension of the artwork to the edge; the 7 cm and 17 cm measurements concern the block-color pareos.

The client's acceptance of the proposed Pantone and CMYK documentation is already represented by a same-message MODIFY, and the block-pareo border measurements do not otherwise change color specifications.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording the 1.5 cm seam allowance and rolled-hem finish; no additional dimension or seam attribute is entailed.
The source selects design details and production measurements but does not change the standing requirement to deliver production-ready final artwork files.
